exposure: History of preterm birth (early preterm, late preterm, full term)
outcome: Severity of lung disease (mean airway pressures, oxygenation index, oxygenation saturation index)
cohort: The study included 163 children (median age 1.8 years) in pediatric ICUs who were treated with INO for a respiratory indication, categorized by their history of early preterm (<32 weeks), late preterm (32-37 weeks), or full-term birth.
finding: INO was used differently in early preterm subjects, who experienced more ventilator-free days and lower 28-day mortality, although lower respiratory tract disease, not prematurity, was independently associated with lower mortality.
gest_age: Early preterm (<32 weeks post-conceptual age at birth), Late preterm (32-37 weeks post-conceptual age at birth)
